text:
emma: Heads-up thread  we need a compact, unambiguous play for SI co-sell + marketplace attribution. last week's back-and-forth with Northpoint leaked into 3 teams and slowed the buyer. want a deterministic rule set we can automate.

josh: Agreed. Draft priority order: 1) SI provided evidence (SOW/invoice/customer-copied email) -> SI owns. 2) Marketplace checkout with partner_id -> SI owns. 3) Redwood-originated inbound (product usage, demo request) -> Redwood owns. 4) Concurrent outreach within 14 days -> joint ownership and split responsibilities.

priya: Add exception: if SI is underwriting a paid pilot (PO/SOW uploaded) they get precedence even when RW originated. Also require claim assertion within 10 days of lead creation or it expires.

oliver: Ops note: marketplace often strips partner metadata. Heuristic: if sku startswith("partner_") OR checkout_ref contains "partner=" OR order_meta.partner_account present -> tag for SI auto-assign. If metadata missing, surface to ops queue with fast follow.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-9422: "marketplace attribution heuristics + auto-assign" assigned to oliver, due 2024-07-25.

emma: we should also standardize the SFDC intake fields and the minimal handoff checklist so buyers don't get ping-ponged. checklist = 1) 1-paragraph summary, 2) named POCs (SI + RW), 3) procurement path, 4) next action + owner. keep it short.

josh: SFDC snippet suggestion for automation: ```
claim_origin: [redwood|si|marketplace]
claim_evidence_type: [sow|invoice|email|portal_action]
claim_evidence_url: string
claim_window_days: 10
primary_owner: [redwood|si|joint]
escalation_contact: partnerships@redwood.com
locked_until: date_or_null
```

priya: For disputes: 3 business day SLA for initial resolution. if unresolved, lock assignment to the party with earliest documented outreach and notify buyer + both parties. escalate to partnerships@redwood.com for manual review if reseller chains present.

oliver: I'll implement the ops workflow for auto-tagging and the ticket for the detection rule. also will add an intake validation: SI_claim requires at least one evidence_url for automated assignment.

emma: can someone prepare a one-pager + quick portal copy and an email template ops can use on locking? template should be: "Hi <buyer>, routing update: primary owner is <entity>. Next step: <X>. Contact: <POC>".

josh: I'll draft the one-pager and the portal blurb. Priya, can you draft the dispute email and the sample wording for the claim expiry?

priya: yes, will share by Wed noon. include anonymized example from ACME scuffle.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach anonymized customer example to playbook doc so we can add to FAQ.

emma: Action items: josh -> one-pager + portal blurb, priya -> dispute templates + SLA wording, oliver -> ops heuristics + ticket updates. target publish by Friday so SEs/sales have guidance next week. :thumbsup:

josh: ack. will include the SFDC snippet and a tiny flow diagram (Assert -> Validate -> Assign/Lock -> Notify).

priya: tagging legal for review of locking SLA. will ping legal separately.

emma: thanks team. this should reduce churn and speed buyer experience. if anyone has a short customer anecdote or edge-case, drop it here and i'll anonymize.
